author: GitHub
description:
Opening a new tool can feel intimidating, but starting a session in the GitHub Copilot app is simple. In this episode, we walk through how to write your very first prompt and add a project context using a local folder or a GitHub repository. We also explore how to select different AI models and use voice prompts to explain your coding problems naturally.

Download the app today and run your first agent session: https://github.com/features/ai/github-app?utm_source=youtube-copilot-app-ep2-description&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=copilot-app-for-beginners-series

#GitHubCopilot #CopilotApp #GitHub
